source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill explicitly declares external API and version lookup as not applicable.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations conditionally omit infrastructure but do not require an explicit local-only or API/version-lookup declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only lookup declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation of a local-only fixture completes without Context7, MCP, or network access.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation verifies that local-only validation avoids all three external access mechanisms.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only validation isolation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local fixture without network configuration passes, while a fixture declaring local-only status together with a network or API dependency fails.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not provide this paired local-only acceptance and contradiction check.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only fixture oracle

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares Context7-first lookup when available and an official HTTPS fallback when Context7 is unavailable.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations contain no lookup-order or official-fallback declaration requirement.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill records the version, source, and retrieval date for lookup information.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation requires these provenance fields for version-sensitive information.
source_gap_claims.subject: Lookup provenance records

source_gap_claims.behavior: Missing or stale version information has an explicit failure or handling policy, and HTTP or arbitrary nonofficial fallback is rejected.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require stale-information behavior or reject these fallback forms.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version information failure policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Historical version records are treated only as syntax/provenance inputs and cannot establish that a version is currently latest.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation limits the evidentiary meaning of historical records in this way.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical version evidence

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation performs no Context7, HTTPS, or other version lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not explicitly prohibit lookup execution during static validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Static validation lookup boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities declare the runtime credential owner, safe reference mechanism, redaction policy, and denied output locations.
source_gap_claims.reason: Generic capability-owner and diagnostic restrictions do not require these four secret-specific declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret capability declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Synthetic literal credential fields or known secret markers, a missing credential owner, or a raw-secret output policy causes validation failure.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require these secret-specific negative checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret declaration negative checks

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-related diagnostics report only the finding location and rule, real credential fixtures are prohibited, and validation makes no universal secret-detection claim.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing diagnostic sanitization and test-data constraints do not establish this secret-specific output scope or the explicit non-claim.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret diagnostic and fixture boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations declare affected scope, the required confirmation or authorization source, and recovery or irreversibility disclosure.
source_gap_claims.reason: The supplied obligations do not require destructive-operation declarations covering these three elements.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive operation declarations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation rejects destructive declarations with missing scope, a bypass flag, or confirmation derived solely from untrusted input.
source_gap_claims.reason: Untrusted-content boundaries do not cover these specific destructive-operation failure checks.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive authorization negative checks

source_gap_claims.behavior: Existing session or user authorization is accepted when the owning policy permits it, without imposing redundant confirmation for every destructive operation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No supplied obligation states this valid authorization path or the prohibition on universal redundant confirmation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive confirmation policy
